note: RV resort beside the Beaver Dam golf course near Madden, north-west of Calgary: open, treeless lots, some premium 'ridge view' lots looking west over the course to the mountains, and adult-oriented facilities. Fully self-contained RV units only; no tents. --Claude
summary: Operator page read: 126 full-service 50/30/20-amp lots, laundry, wifi, season mid-April to Thanksgiving Monday, phone booking, daily/weekly/monthly/seasonal; NO posted nightly rate (call for pricing). Pin is on the clubhouse ~500 m SE of the RV loops. RV resort phone differs from stored pro-shop line.
flags: PRIVATE GATES: no posted nightly RV rate and no booking engine ('Looking for our RV Resort pricing? Give us a call at 587-436-5204'). RV Life tier $$ (stored rating; RV Life avg_rate 36, highest_rate 53, 113 sites, 4* over 16 reviews) is the only price indicator. Google Maps: 4.1 stars from 410 reviews, phone +1 403-946-5200, website beaverdamgolf.ca. Presence passes (working website with phones). Gateway: none within 40 km (Calgary 47 km, Banff NP 94 km).

LONG-STAY (report, reviewer's call): the operator markets 'We accept daily, weekly, monthly, or seasonal bookings' and posts no nightly price. Esri imagery (leaf-off, brown grass, so spring or fall; capture date unknown) shows nearly every one of the ~126 pads in all three rows occupied by RVs. RV Life's review summary is traveller-oriented ('wide and level back-in sites', 'within reach of Calgary and Banff'; concerns: 'stray golf balls at certain sites', 'issues with management communication', 'no showers or bathhouses on site'). Five tests: 1 nights are sold by phone with no application/lease/waitlist stated - pass; 2 no posted nightly rate - FAILS if the park is read as long-stay in character (RV Life $$ is the only price); 3 no standing minimum stated - pass; 4 nightly share UNMEASURED (no engine; imagery suggests mostly occupied, consistent with many seasonals but not proof); 5 not a home community - pass. I read it as borderline: possibly mostly seasonal, unproven.

PHONE: stored 403-946-5200 is the golf 'TEE TIMES / PRO SHOP' line (resort map PDF; also the Google listing number). The RV resort's own line on the RV page, contact page and map is 587-436-5204 (email info@/Kendall@beaverdamgolf.ca). Recommend 587-436-5204.
WEBSITE: stored http://www.beaverdamgolf.ca/ answers 200 (redirects to https://beaverdamgolf.ca/); the RV page is https://beaverdamgolf.ca/rv-resort/ (200) - recommend it.

PIN MOVE: stored 51.4387,-114.2839 is on the clubhouse/pro shop parking lot (Google's pin for the golf course). The RV resort's three rows of lots lie ~450-550 m north-west, between the clubhouse road and the creek; centre on Esri imagery about 51.4420,-114.2888. Recommend 51.4420,-114.2888.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront): confirmed. A small creek winds west of the 200-row through a treed draw, and golf ponds sit beside the RV office; no page claims water. Not waterfront.
